subject.title: Feature Request: Per-model turn limits with auto-revert

question: Should OpenClaw add a session-owned multi-turn model lease for `/model --turns N`, and what public/config API should own per-model max-turn limits plus warning/revert semantics?
rationale: The request adds slash-command syntax, config surface, persisted session state, and provider/model routing behavior, and it overlaps with open one-turn and fallback-revert work; automation can identify the paths but should not choose the product contract.

options.title: Specify a unified lease contract
options.body: Define one maintainer-approved session lease design first, then implement `/model --turns N` and any Gateway/session API shape against that shared contract.

options.title: Sequence after one-turn API
options.body: Keep this issue open but settle the one-turn override API before designing multi-turn lease counters and config.

options.title: Decline native leases
options.body: Document manual `/model default`, one-turn overrides, or external operational policy as the supported cost-governance path instead of adding persistent lease state.

recommendation.title: Specify a unified lease contract
recommendation.body: Define one maintainer-approved session lease design first, then implement `/model --turns N` and any Gateway/session API shape against that shared contract.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest history signal is on the existing session model override, auth-profile preservation, and Gateway patch paths that would own the contract.
